name: Ichimoku Cloud Trend Following — USD/JPY
description: Trend-following strategy on USD/JPY using Ichimoku Cloud signals. Long entry when Tenkan-sen crosses above Kijun-sen with both lines above the cloud (no Chikou filter). Short entry when Tenkan crosses below Kijun with both lines below the cloud AND Chikou span below the price it overlays (close >> 26 < close >> 52). Risk-based position sizing via risk_unit: 2% of account equity risked per trade with stop distance set to 2×ATR(14). Trailing stop at 2×ATR(14) dynamically follows price. Standard Ichimoku parameters: Tenkan=9, Kijun=26, Senkou B=52.
source:
# Ichimoku Cloud Trend Following — USD/JPY
# =============================================================================
# Entry:
#   Long  → Tenkan crosses above Kijun AND both above the cloud
#   Short → Tenkan crosses below Kijun AND both below the cloud
# Exit:
#   Trailing stop at 2 × ATR(14) for all positions
# Sizing:
#   100% allocation per position (one position at a time)
# Ichimoku params: Tenkan=9, Kijun=26, Senkou B=52
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# =============================================================================
# ICHIMOKU CLOUD (standard parameters)
# =============================================================================
ichi = ichimoku(p_tenkan=9, p_kijun=26, p_senkou_b=52)(high, low, close)

tenkan = ichi.tenkan
kijun = ichi.kijun
senkou_a = ichi.senkou_a
senkou_b = ichi.senkou_b

# Cloud upper/lower boundaries (cloud top = max of Senkou A/B, bottom = min)
# "Above cloud" means above BOTH spans; "below cloud" means below BOTH spans
cloud_top = senkou_a if senkou_a > senkou_b else senkou_b
cloud_bottom = senkou_a if senkou_a < senkou_b else senkou_b

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# TK Cross signals (pulse — true for 1 bar only)
tk_cross_bull = crossover(tenkan, kijun)
tk_cross_bear = crossunder(tenkan, kijun)

# Cloud filter: both Tenkan and Kijun must be above/below the cloud
# Lag by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias (Senkou spans use current bar data)
cloud_top_prev = cloud_top >> 1
cloud_bottom_prev = cloud_bottom >> 1
tenkan_prev = tenkan >> 1
kijun_prev = kijun >> 1

above_cloud = (tenkan_prev > cloud_top_prev) and (kijun_prev > cloud_top_prev)
below_cloud = (tenkan_prev < cloud_bottom_prev) and (kijun_prev < cloud_bottom_prev)

# Chikou span confirmation
# Chikou span = current close displaced 26 bars back on the chart
# For confirmation, compare the Chikou value against the price of the candle it overlays:
#   Long:  close >> 26 > close >> 52  (Chikou above price 26 bars ago)
#   Short: close >> 26 < close >> 52  (Chikou below price 26 bars ago)
chikou_bull = (close >> 26) > (close >> 52)
chikou_bear = (close >> 26) < (close >> 52)

# Hold the TK cross state until the opposing cross fires
# This prevents the pulse from being lost if the cloud filter isn't met on the exact crossover bar
long_state = hold_until()(enter=tk_cross_bull, exit=tk_cross_bear)
short_state = hold_until()(enter=tk_cross_bear, exit=tk_cross_bull)

# Combine held state with filters for final entry signals
# Long: TK cross + above cloud (no Chikou requirement)
# Short: TK cross + below cloud + Chikou span confirmation
long_entry = long_state and above_cloud
short_entry = short_state and below_cloud and chikou_bear

# =============================================================================
# ATR FOR TRAILING STOP
# =============================================================================
atr_val = atr(period=14)(high, low, close)
trail_dist = 2 * atr_val

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Long & short zone — both directions
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Risk-based sizing: 2% of account risked per trade
# Stop distance = 2×ATR(14), so position size = (account × 2%) / (2×ATR)
# risk_unit bundles sizing + a fixed stop; trailing_stop also active at same distance
# but trails price — whichever triggers first exits the trade
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price)(risk_pct=2, stop_distance=trail_dist)

# 2x ATR trailing stop for all positions
trailing_stop()(distance=trail_dist)
